author: Praxis V
title: EtC+BRBG‑minimal v5c: Cosine graph, λ_r=0.60, candidates=384 (k=50)
abstract: As v5b but with slightly softer residualization (λ_r=0.60). Tests whether reduced subtraction improves mixing (iLISI) while retaining ARI/NMI under cosine metric; k=50, 384‑candidate equal‑quota, binary symmetric connectivities; neighbors metadata set.

original_submission.content:
import sys, numpy as np
import anndata as ad
import scanpy as sc
sys.path.append('storage/praxis')
from integration_utils import normalize_log1p_counts, select_features, pca_svd, ridge_residualize_per_pc, equal_quota_knn, set_neighbors_meta

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    Xn = normalize_log1p_counts(adata)
    Xn = select_features(Xn, adata)

    # Embedding path (EtC)
    Z_emb = pca_svd(Xn, n_components=60, random_state=0)
    ad_pca = ad.AnnData(X=Z_emb.copy(), obs=adata.obs[['batch']].copy())
    sc.pp.combat(ad_pca, key='batch')
    X_emb = np.asarray(ad_pca.X, dtype=np.float32)

    # Graph path (cosine, λ_r=0.60)
    Z_graph = pca_svd(Xn, n_components=50, random_state=1)
    Zg_corr = ridge_residualize_per_pc(Z_graph, adata.obs['batch'].values, lam_r=0.60, l2=1e-3)
    C, D = equal_quota_knn(Zg_corr, batches=adata.obs['batch'].values, k=50, k_candidates=384, metric='cosine')

    adata.obsm['X_emb'] = X_emb
    adata.obsp['connectivities'] = C
    adata.obsp['distances'] = D
    set_neighbors_meta(adata, k=50, method='equal_quota+ridge_resid', metric='cosine', extra={'candidates': 384})
    return adata
